description: A finding, recorded as an expected failure: logH-TTL × KDK at one fixed fictitious step on Hristov et al.'s free-fall orbit sol_80.txt row 1 reads ξ 1.9e-8, above the threshold, because the orbit amplifies an error by 1.9e6 over one period, where the threshold allowed 1000 (validation::reversibility's note). The reading is round-off, not a broken reversal: ρ = ξ/(2n·u·A) is reported at most 1e-2. The threshold is not moved; the owner decides the criterion.
